eyebrow: Making any operation safe to retry
code:
client: key = generate_unique_id()
client: send(charge_card, key)

server: if key in processed_keys:
          return stored_result[key]   // duplicate — replay, don't redo
        else:
          result = charge_card()
          processed_keys[key] = result
          return result
caption: An idempotency key turns a non-idempotent operation into a safe retry.

eyebrow: Safe to retry isn't the same as free to retry
